# ServiceIdentity

`serviceusage.gcp.hfl.dev/v1beta1`

**Gap it fills.** a folder's or an organization's service agent (Terraform's `google_folder_service_identity`, `google_organization_service_identity`), its email in status for IAM grants; Config Connector's `ServiceIdentity` takes a project only

**Source.** Config Connector's direct `ServiceIdentity`; types and mapper generated by `hack/scaffold-kind.sh`

## Notes

2026-11-15: first live run on the test folder. It failed once: a folder's
`generateServiceIdentity` answers an operation already done, named
`operations/finished.DONE_OPERATION`, which `operations.get` refuses; the
controller now takes a done operation as it is (patch 0051 makes mockgcp
answer the same). Then it passed, and the kind moved from
`serviceusage.gcp.hfl.dev/v1alpha1` to `v1beta1` with its schema unchanged
(`docs/design.md` decision 27); `v1alpha1` is no longer served, and
`CHANGELOG.md` says how to upgrade. The organization parent runs on the
fake only (a live run never touches the organization). It is Cloud
Foundation Fabric's folder and organization `service_agents_config`
(decision 35).

Notes from before 2026-11-11 are in `docs/design.md` (section 6 and
section 7, under the kind's name); new ones go here.
